title: trustdiff policy
description: The .trustdiff.yaml policy file, version 1. Unknown keys are errors.

version.description: Policy file format version. Only 1 exists.

cooldown.description: Versions younger than this are reported by young-version (TD001). Spellings: 12h, 3d, 1w, 3d12h, or ISO 8601 such as P3D and PT12H.

cooldown_exclude.description: Package patterns exempt from the cooldown: [<ecosystem>:]<name>[@<version>] with * and ? globs (** is not supported).

previous_versions_window.description: How many previous versions publisher-changed (TD002) looks back at. At least 1; leave the key out for the default.

allow.description: Reviewed exceptions. Each names the check, the package pattern and the reason; an expiry date is strongly recommended.

reason.description: Why the exception exists and who reviewed it.

expires.description: Last day the exception applies, as YYYY-MM-DD. After that day the entry is reported as expired.

on_data_unavailable.description: warn: report affected checks as skipped and keep the exit code. fail: report them as skipped and exit with code 3.

ecosystems.description: Per-ecosystem overrides for cooldown and checks.

duration.description: 12h, 3d, 1w, 3d12h (lowercase units, fractions allowed) or ISO 8601: PnW, PnD, PTnHnMnS, PnDTnHnMnS, each with at least one component.

level.description: block makes the exit code 1, warn and info are reported, off disables the check.

plainCheck.description: A level, or an object with the level only.

vulnerabilityCheck.description: A level, or an object with the level and min_severity (low, medium, high, critical).

lowUsageCheck.description: A level, or an object with the level and min_weekly_downloads.

checks.description: Level and options of each check. Only the checks listed here exist.

doctor.description: Settings for "trustdiff doctor", which reads the hardening settings the repository's package managers support. Every key is optional, and so is the section: leaving it out reports every rule at the level the rule itself carries.

ci_min_severity.description: The lowest level a missing or wrong setting has to reach for "doctor --ci" to exit 1. Default: warn.

pin_exceptions.description: Workflow references a project has decided may stay on a tag, as globs over owner/repo. Default: none, and the SLSA generator is known to the tool and needs no entry.

doctorRules.description: The level of each doctor rule, by rule name such as npm-min-release-age. Default: the level the rule itself carries; off turns the rule off.

pinException.description: A glob over owner/repo, such as myorg/* or myorg/actions.
